research.title: Semantic Segmentation Robustness Under Adverse Imaging Conditions
bullets: Designed controlled experiments comparing segmentation models under synthetic fog, motion blur, and exposure shifts while holding training data and preprocessing constant.
Analyzed classwise intersection over union and boundary errors to distinguish sensitivity to image degradation from failures involving small objects.

research.title: Calibration of Image Classifiers Under Distribution Shift
bullets: Designed evaluation protocols comparing temperature scaling and uncalibrated predictions across clean images, common corruptions, and held out visual categories.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, calibration error, and selective prediction curves to characterize relationships between confidence, classification accuracy, and corruption severity.

research.title: Evaluating Visual Representations for Limited Label Recognition
bullets: Designed experiments comparing frozen feature extraction and supervised fine tuning across controlled label subsets using consistent data splits and augmentation settings.
Analyzed class confusion, nearest neighbor retrievals, and variation across training runs to examine representation quality and sensitivity to label availability.

projects.title: Classical and Learned Features for Image Retrieval
bullets: Implemented image retrieval pipelines using color histograms, local feature aggregation, and pretrained convolutional embeddings with consistent image preprocessing.
Compared retrieval precision and ranked examples across viewpoint changes and background clutter, documenting characteristic errors for each feature representation.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Stereo Matching Methods
bullets: Implemented block matching and semi global matching pipelines with configurable matching costs, disparity ranges, and left right consistency checks.
Compared disparity errors on annotated stereo pairs and inspected failures near occlusion boundaries, reflective surfaces, and regions with weak texture.

projects.title: Image Denoising with Spatial Filters and Convolutional Networks
bullets: Implemented median filtering, bilateral filtering, and a convolutional denoising baseline using paired clean and synthetically corrupted images.
Compared reconstruction quality using peak signal to noise ratio and structural similarity, examining edge preservation across noise types and intensities.

projects.title: Transfer Learning Strategies for Fine Grained Image Classification
bullets: Implemented linear probing, partial backbone tuning, and full fine tuning for a pretrained image classifier under a shared training protocol.
Compared validation accuracy, training behavior, and class confusion across adaptation strategies, inspecting errors among categories with similar shapes and textures.
